description: Interprocedural, cross-module command injection through Express request data. Also contains reflected XSS: the same caller-supplied value comes back out in a text/html response body. One source, two sinks, two weaknesses, one policy.

expected.note: crosses a function and a module boundary
encodeURIComponent is a URL encoder and must not clear a shell sink
tainted executable path; the channel determines the weakness identity, not the policy
the command output is echoed into a text/html body
encodeURIComponent does not neutralize markup either
reached through a second route sharing the helper
